description: This file defines the openXSchemaEditor class, which manages database schema operations such as creating, comparing, and updating schema definitions, as well as handling transitional files, versioning, and XML-RPC registration within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: openXSchemaEditor
classes.description: A utility class for managing database schema definitions, including creation, comparison, validation, versioning, and migration within the Revive Adserver environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the schema editor, setting up paths, loading schema definitions, and preparing the MDB2_Schema object.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new database schema definition XML file with the specified name.

methods.name: createChangeset
methods.description: Generates a changeset XML by comparing current and previous schema definitions.

methods.name: saveChangeset
methods.description: Saves a changeset from an input file, possibly splitting it into parts.

methods.name: createTransitional
methods.description: Creates transitional schema and links files for editing.

methods.name: commitFinal
methods.description: Finalizes transitional files, copying them to final locations and creating associated changesets.

methods.name: _getNextVersion
methods.description: Calculates the next version number for schema updates.

methods.name: _getBasename
methods.description: Generates a basename for output files based on the schema filename and version.

methods.name: setWorkingFiles
methods.description: Assigns transitional or final schema and links files for editing.

methods.name: parseWorkingDefinitionFile
methods.description: Parses the current working schema XML into an internal array.

methods.name: writeWorkingDefinitionFile
methods.description: Writes the current schema definition array to an XML file.

methods.name: deleteTransitional
methods.description: Removes transitional schema and links files.

methods.name: deleteLinksTrans
methods.description: Deletes transitional links file.

methods.name: deleteChangesTrans
methods.description: Deletes transitional changeset file.

methods.name: deleteSchemaTrans
methods.description: Deletes transitional schema file.

methods.name: fieldSave
methods.description: Validates and updates a table field, cascading changes to indexes and links.

methods.name: fieldAdd
methods.description: Adds a new field to a table based on a data dictionary definition.

methods.name: fieldDelete
methods.description: Removes a field from a table, updating indexes and links accordingly.

methods.name: fieldWasSave
methods.description: Records a 'was' (previous) field name in a changeset for renaming purposes.

methods.name: tableWasSave
methods.description: Records a 'was' (previous) table name in a changeset for renaming purposes.

methods.name: indexDelete
methods.description: Removes an index from a table.

methods.name: indexAdd
methods.description: Adds a new index to a table.

methods.name: indexSave
methods.description: Validates and updates an index definition.

methods.name: tableNew
methods.description: Creates a new table with a default ID field.

methods.name: tableDelete
methods.description: Deletes a table and its link relations.

methods.name: tableSave
methods.description: Renames a table, updating links and definitions.

methods.name: linkDelete
methods.description: Removes a link from a table.

methods.name: linkAdd
methods.description: Adds a link to a table.

methods.name: readForeignKeys
methods.description: Reads foreign key links for a table.

methods.name: getLinkTargets
methods.description: Builds an array of cross-referenced link targets.

methods.name: validate_table
methods.description: Validates table properties using schema validator.

methods.name: validate_field
methods.description: Validates field properties using schema validator.

methods.name: validate_index
methods.description: Validates index properties using schema validator.

methods.name: updateFieldIndexRelations
methods.description: Updates index definitions to reflect field renames.

methods.name: updateFieldLinkRelations
methods.description: Updates link definitions to reflect field renames.

methods.name: deleteTableLinkRelations
methods.description: Removes link relations for a deleted table.

methods.name: updateTableLinkRelations
methods.description: Updates link relations for renamed tables.

methods.name: init_schema_validator
methods.description: Initializes the schema validation object.

methods.name: writeMigrationClass
methods.description: Generates a PHP migration class based on a changeset.

methods.name: _buildBuffers
methods.description: Builds task and method code snippets for migration class.

methods.name: _buildTask
methods.description: Creates a migration task line.

methods.name: _buildMap
methods.description: Builds object mapping code for migration.

methods.name: _buildMethod
methods.description: Creates a migration class method.

methods.name: testChangeset
methods.description: Debug method to compare and dump changeset differences.

methods.name: _generateDataObjects
methods.description: Rebuilds DataObject PHP classes based on schema changes.

methods.name: _registerVersion
methods.description: Registers schema version via XML-RPC server.

methods.name: _getNextVersionXMLRPC
methods.description: Gets the next schema version number via XML-RPC.
